product.title: Vilvah Melt-in-Milk Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++ 50ml
product.descriptionHtml:
• Broad-Spectrum Protection: Provides SPF 50 PA+++ to shield skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays.
  • Acne-Safe Formula: Designed to be non-comedogenic, preventing breakouts and clogged pores.
  • No White Cast: Absorbs quickly without leaving a visible residue, suitable for all skin tones.
  • Water-Resistant: Ideal for active lifestyles, offering protection during swimming or sweating.
  • Suitable for All Skin Types: Gentle enough for daily use on oily, dry, and combination skin.
